svg.title: Two requests, one page, compare the status codes
svg.desc: Request A is a normal request. Request B sends the GPTBot user-agent. Same status means no user-agent rule. A 403 on B only means a rule targets the crawler's name. A 429 or 503 on both is rate limiting or an outage.

g.text: Two requests, one page: compare the status codes
Request B: sends the GPTBot user-agent
No rule on the user-agent name. Your host may still judge crawlers by IP address, so check the logs too.
A rule blocks the GPTBot name. Find it in your CDN, plugin or server config.
Rate limiting or an outage hits every visitor, not only crawlers. Retry later before you change rules.
Status code meanings: 403 Forbidden, 429 Too Many Requests, 503 Service Unavailable (HTTP standard, RFC 9110).
